summary: Saint Paul was the apostle of the Gentiles and a teacher of the faith. His letters reveal the grace of Christ and the call to missionary zeal.
antiphon_text: Let us remember Saint Paul as a faithful witness to the love and mercy of Christ.
prayer_text: Lord God, through the life of Saint Paul, strengthen us to follow your path with courage and charity. Grant us the grace to bear faithful witness in our own time. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.
